import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    MAX = 10005
    t = [0] * MAX
    
    n = int(input())
    for _ in range(n):
        m = int(input())
        t[m] += 1
    
    k = int(input())
    for i in range(1, 3001):
        t[i] += t[i-1]
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, 5001 - k + 1):
        ans = max(ans, t[i+k] - t[i-1])
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
